say:1:1322560001:1.text: Sofio! What are you still doing here? Shouldn't you be home for lunch?
say:1:1322560001:1.source_cn: 索菲娅，你怎么还没有回家吃饭呢？

say:2:1322560002:1.text: Hey, King... are you gonna leave Cedartown? Does that mean we can't hang out anymore?
say:2:1322560002:1.source_cn: 大王，你是不是总会离开雪松镇啊？这样是不是就没办法再陪...
say:2:1322560002:1.male: Hey, King... are you gonna leave Cedartown? Does that mean we can't hang out anymore?
say:2:1322560002:1.female: Hey, King... are you gonna leave Cedartown? Does that mean we can't hang out anymore?

say:3:1322560003:0.text: In that case... I'll make a snowman... A snowman that represents you, King! 'Cause I've never met anyone as awesome as you!
say:3:1322560003:0.source_cn: 所以……我、我想堆一个雪人！代表大王的雪人！因为我从来...
say:3:1322560003:0.male: In that case... I'll make a snowman... A snowman that represents you, King! 'Cause I've never met anyone as awesome as you!
say:3:1322560003:0.female: In that case... I'll make a snowman... A snowman that represents you, King! 'Cause I've never met anyone as awesome as you!

say:4:1322560004:1.text: But... I'm too hungry to make it on my own. You've gotta help, King!
say:4:1322560004:1.source_cn: 不过，我太饿了，没有力气，大王你也要一起来帮忙喔！
say:4:1322560004:1.male: But... I'm too hungry to make it on my own. You've gotta help, King!
say:4:1322560004:1.female: But... I'm too hungry to make it on my own. You've gotta help, King!
